sections.title: Section 93 - Deductions from Payment to Actors, Actresses, Producers etc (1) A person responsible for paying part or all of the money for the purchase
sections.content_text: Section 93 - Deductions from Payment to Actors, Actresses, Producers etc (1) A person responsible for paying part or all of the money for the purchase of a film, drama or television or radio program on the money paid or payable at the time of payment or deposit as payee, deduct tax at the rate of (ten percent). (2) A person shall deduct tax at the rate of 10% (ten percent) on the amount payable or paid to any person on payment of part or full amount to another person for acting in a film, drama, advertisement or any television or radio program, or on deposit to a payee.
